description: National Water Supply & Drainage Board - Land Acquisition - Ambakotewattha, Kundasale D/S Division, Kandy District - Koddadi, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District - Koyyathoddam, Jaffna D/S Division, Jaffna District
categorisation: This gazette content primarily deals with land acquisition matters. It contains three separate orders under the National Water Supply and Drainage Board Act approving the acquisition of specific immovable properties (land parcels) for water supply and sanitation projects. The content includes detailed descriptions of the land parcels, their boundaries, locations, and claimants, which falls squarely under Land Gazettes (Type 4) for land acquisitions and property matters. While a minister is named, this is incidental to the land acquisition process rather than being about government personnel changes or portfolio responsibilities.
